clips.name: Peeks up at the Name Wall
Waves goodbye with the whole arm
Plays the ghost in its story
Traces a name in the air
Reads old names by lantern light
Counts the remembered days on its ribs
Ponders with a hand to the jaw
Lifts both hands to the Three
Lays a hand on the heart
Lifts the lantern to see you
Traces the point in the air
Traces a name for a neighbour
Recites the names from the Wall
Tends the lantern on the staff
Lights a lantern on a high post
Scatters wart seed in an arc
Holds a carving to the light
Sniffs the brew without a nose
Thumps the shaft and lifts the free hand
Makes the point with a thump of the shaft
Leans on the shaft to talk
Hand to the heart and a thump of the shaft
